answer_1.quote: We test AMRCOT on paraphrase detection, machine translation, logical fallacy detection, event extraction, and text-to-SQL generation.

answer_2.quote: We report the performance of PAWS, Logic, and Pubmed45 by F1 scores, the performance of machine translation on the WMT16 dataset by BLEU scores, and the performance of text-to-SQL generation using the official evaluation setup.
